component: Calendar provider and editor interface checks

quotes.text: rule instanceof CalRecurrenceRule || rule instanceof Ci.calIRecurrenceRule

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch uses guarded QueryInterface for the cached provider's changelog capability, with false on absence or error because an implementation may come from an add-on compartment. The same patch deliberately uses implementation-or-interface instanceof checks for a recurrence rule in the editor. CalDAV redirects separately catch upload extraction and then require HTTP channel interfaces. These distinct source forms follow their receiver and caller contracts; they do not establish one global interface-check style or a successful add-on/redirect runtime result.
title: Calendar interface checks keep provider capabilities separate from recurrence objects
